info.name: Hotel Management System
info.description:
Complete API collection for Hotel Management System.

Authentication: Protected routes require two headers:
- authorization: <token>
- usertype: SuperAdmin | Admin | Employee | User

Workflow:
1. Register/Login to get a token
2. Set the token in collection variables
3. Use the appropriate folder to test routes

Base URL: http://localhost:6587/api/v1

item.name: 🌐 Public Routes (No Auth)
item.description: These routes do NOT require authentication. Use them to register, login, and browse hotels publicly.

item.name: Public - Get Rooms By Hotel Id
🏨 Hotel Admin
